post.title: Why South Korea's Exports Nearly Doubled in October
post.ig:
South Korea's exports just jumped 93.7%. Blame AI.
October exports hit $115.3 billion, a record for October, released Nov 1.
Chips alone were $56.4 billion, up 259%, nearly half the total.
Shipments to the US rose 185.8% to $24.9 billion.
A holiday shift helped: per workday, exports rose 76%.
Sources: Korea Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources; Korea Times; Seoul Economic Daily.
